text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-autoscaler (PD: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC123456) - symptom: queue backlog > 50k, pods saturated, autoscaler not scaling :rotating_light:

pagerduty: auto-page to level-1 oncall: Maya Chen

Maya Chen: ACK - paging in. seeing heavy enqueue rate from api-prod. queue length 52,340 and growing.

Maya Chen: quick checks:
- 95th latency spikes to ~3.2s
- worker pods at 100% GPU util, OOM/killing = 0
- HPA target CPU at 80% but replicas stuck at 8

Sam Ortiz: copying logs from the scaler:
```
2026-03-14T09:12:02Z scaler ERROR reconcile: failed to scale up: quota exceeded for project-redwood-dedicated
2026-03-14T09:12:17Z scaler WARN skipped scale event: cooldown in effect
2026-03-14T09:13:05Z scaler INFO desired_replicas=24 current=8
```

Alex Rivera: looks like autoscaler computed desired=24 but couldn't apply due to quota. can we push temporary quota or move some workload?

Priya Patel: checking GCP quota now. also looking at recent deploys — any traffic change?

Maya Chen: traffic spike from customer cohort 'beta-search' + sudden batch jobs at 09:10. I can throttle that cohort via route rule for now.

Sam Ortiz: mitigation plan: (1) temporarily increase replica count manually to dissipate queue, (2) throttle non-critical traffic, (3) open emergency quota request / use emergency capacity pool if available, (4) if scaling still fails fallback to lightweight model variant.

Maya Chen: doing step 1: scaling workers to 24 replicas now
```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-workers -n prod --replicas=24
deployment.apps/inference-workers scaled
```

incident-bot: Action logged: manual scale performed by Maya Chen

Maya Chen: scaling took ~45s. queue length dropped from 52k -> 18k, dequeue rate improved. 95th latency down to ~1.8s.

Priya Patel: GCP quota shows GPU quota at limit for us in region us-west1. emergency quota request submitted to cloud console (REQ-789). Approved? pending.

Alex Rivera: if quota won't come through, we should migrate some low-priority jobs to dedicated-spot or preemption-tolerant pool. I can carve out 6 pods from the spot pool and attach them if needed.

Maya Chen: enabling route throttle for beta-search now to reduce new enqueues by ~70%
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","match":"beta-search","rate_limit":"30r/s"}
```

pagerduty: Incident INC123456 acknowledged by Maya Chen at 2026-03-14T09:15:12Z

Sam Ortiz: monitoring metrics: error rate up from 0.8% -> 6.9% at peak. SLOs impacted for ~10 minutes. Customer-facing impact: elevated latency and occasional 429s for queued requests.

Maya Chen: marking customer-impact = partial (search beta customers + some bulk ingestion). Notifying CS with a short blurb.

Priya Patel: cloud ops approved hot add? still pending, but support said ETA ~20m.

Alex Rivera: prepping rollback of recent federated batch job that saturated enqueues. If cloud add delayed, I'll kill the batch job to free capacity.

Maya Chen: batch job identified: job-id=ingest-20260314-539. going to pause it in 60s if we don't see enough drop.

Sam Ortiz: escalation policy: if not resolved in 15m escalate to SRE lead (Sam Ortiz -> Alex Rivera -> Priya). Timer started.

incident-bot: escalation timer set (15m) by Maya Chen

Maya Chen: update: after scaling + throttle, queue down to 6.2k, latency 95th ~1.3s, errors ~1.5%. Going to keep monitoring.

pagerduty: Incident INC123456: status=acknowledged, urgency=high, owner=Maya Chen

Priya Patel: cloud support updated: emergency capacity provisioned, adding 8 GPUs to project region; will appear as new nodes in ~8m.

Alex Rivera: once new nodes come up we should switch autoscaler back to managed mode and remove manual replica override. also schedule follow-up to enhance autoscaler error visibility (current logs too vague).

Maya Chen: agreed. for now I'll keep replicas at 24 until autoscaler healthy + capacity available.

Sam Ortiz: customer comms drafted and sent to CS: short note explaining transient latency and that mitigation is in place.

Maya Chen: turning over to next on-call: @Alex Rivera (oncall) — I'll run a short handoff at 10:15 and create a post-incident ticket with timeline + RCA owners.

Alex Rivera: ACK takeover at 10:15. will watch for autoscaler reconciliation and cloud capacity arrival.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC123456: occurrence annotated (manual-scale by Maya Chen)

Maya Chen: post-incident actions for follow-up:
- add autoscaler quota/error metrics to alerting (Sam)
- add emergency capacity runbook and contact list (Priya)
- evaluate rate-limiting per-customer defaults to avoid single cohort spikes (Product/Platform)
- add test to simulate quota-failure in staging (Alex)

Alex Rivera: I'll open a Jira: INF-9876 with those action items and assign owners.

pagerduty: Incident INC123456 resolved/closed by Maya Chen at 2026-03-14T10:01:08Z (post-mitigations healthy).

Maya Chen: closing thread. leaving notes in the handoff doc. :white_check_mark:
